purpose: Review a finite six-concept catalog against the frozen 156-definition and 142-comparator library, select at most one contract-permitted historical mechanism, and stop before every minute-source, candidate, comparator, daily-price or forward-return value.

complete_definition_inventory_reconstruc.reconstructor: Campaign146 complete definitions plus the immutable terminal Campaign151 definition

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_session_total_amount_magnitude_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: For the exact 240 continuous-auction bars, require finite nonnegative raw CNY amount and a strictly positive sum S; return log1p(S).
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: exact 240-bar grid, raw CNY unit, natural log1p transform and no cross-sectional or time-series normalization
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The complete library contains activity support, turnover rate and many normalized amount timing, shape and coupling statistics, but no absolute session CNY-liquidity magnitude. log1p is strictly increasing and therefore only provides a finite stable serialization of total amount; it creates no threshold, fit or learned parameter.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_session_market_amount_share_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Divide each stock's session total amount by the same-date sum across eligible stocks.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: For a fixed signal date the positive market denominator is common to every stock, so cross-sectional ordering is exactly the selected total-amount ordering while adding a peer-support gate.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_positive_bar_mean_amount_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Divide session total amount by the count of strictly positive amount bars.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The denominator is the already terminal active-bar support state, so the proposal is a post-exposure combination rather than an independent observation.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_maximum_bar_amount_magnitude_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Return log1p of the largest amount among the exact 240 bars.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: It replaces full-session liquidity magnitude with one exposed extreme and reopens the terminal peak-magnitude/peak-timing family through an alternate estimator.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_session_total_share_volume_magnitude_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Return log1p of total raw provider share volume over the exact 240 bars.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Raw share volume changes with lot and corporate-action denomination and is approximately monetary amount divided by the already exposed transaction-price/affordability state; it is not a cleaner independent liquidity channel.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_session_total_amount_growth_1s
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Compare current total amount with the immediately previous accepted session's total amount.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: proposed prior-session ratio or log difference
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Once absolute total amount is selected, choosing ratio versus difference and one versus multiple prior sessions is an alternate temporal parameterization of the same liquidity-magnitude state and is frozen out before values.

selection.reason: This is the first complete-library definition whose raw information state is absolute full-session CNY transaction-amount magnitude rather than activity support, a normalized intraday distribution, a price/return coupling, turnover normalization or a peer-relative clock statistic.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_session_total_amount_magnitude_240m
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: Greater full-session monetary trading capacity and attention may reduce next-open execution friction and sustain short-lived demand through the third close.
